name: gen_travel_itinerary_kyoto_osaka
task: A traveler dictates a clean, formatted 3-day Japan travel itinerary with bookings, budgets, and a packing list.

turns.say: Heading Japan weekend itinerary, Kyoto plus Osaka, okay, keep it simple and readable.
New paragraph. Dates: March twenty second to March twenty fourth, two nights total.
Day one, arrive Kyoto around eleven thirty a m; no wait, make that ten thirty a m.
Hotel: Sakura Inn, two hundred twenty dollars per night, check in after three.
Afternoon: Fushimi Inari hike, then dinner budget forty five dollars, maybe ramen.
Day two: early Arashiyama bamboo grove, then train to Osaka, fare fifteen dollars.
Make that a list: tickets, passport, charger, reusable bottle, and one rain jacket.
Scratch that, remove reusable bottle. Add note: keep total budget under six hundred dollars.

judge.criteria: Output should be a formatted itinerary with a clear heading, date range converted to figures, day-by-day sections, prices as figures with currency, and a bulleted packing list excluding the retracted item.
